title: BB codes are bivariate bicycle CSS LDPC constructions

claim.statement: The paper defines BB codes as CSS LDPC codes QC(A,B) built from commuting bivariate shift-matrix polynomials; the resulting family has weight-6 checks and a degree-6 Tanner graph with thickness at most 2.
qualifiers: special case of a lifted-product construction over Z_l x Z_m

provenance.section: Section 4 Bivariate Bicycle quantum LDPC codes
